item.title: Why you should NOT doubt Kalen DeBoer 🏈 Alabama's Greatest QB of ALL TIME is...
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Kalen DeBoer is one of the best coaches in college football. His numbers tell the story. So why do people, including some Alabama fans, continue to doubt him as the leader of the Crimson Tide? Kyle Henderson (of Bama Football on YouTube with Kyle Henderson) joins Ben Flanagan to talk about the narrative around DeBoer entering his third season, the ongoing Bama QB battle, new players fans will know very soon, his biggest question mark for 2026 (it'll surprise you), and more. Plus, Kyle pick's the greatest Alabama quarterback of all time in a game of knockout.

item.title: Is ANYBODY scared of Alabama anymore?! with ESPN's Jordan Rodgers and Peter Burns!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Are people losing faith in Alabama? The media predicted the Crimson Tide to finish sixth in the SEC in 2026. This is not normal in Tuscaloosa. "Beat Everyone" host Ben Flanagan reacts to those projections, while AL.com's Nick Kelly has three more outstanding interviews from SEC Media Days in Tampa. ESPN and SEC Network analyst Jordan Rodgers, ESPN and SEC Network host Peter Burns, and veteran journalist and longtime chronicler of the Crimson Tide Kirk McNair talk about the perception of the Crimson Tide entering this season and share stories every Bama fan will want to hear!

item.title: Alabama football legends TELL ALL! Roman Harper, Damien Harris, & Zabien Brown from SEC MEDIA DAYS!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Beat Everyone is in Tampa for SEC Media Days 2026. AL.com Alabama beat reporter and podcast correspondent Nick Kelly is back with three VERY special guests, all of them Crimson Tide legends! ESPN and SEC Network analyst Roman Harper, current Alabama defensive back Zabien Brown, and CBS Sports analyst Damien Harris all sit down with Nick to talk all things Bama, including thoughts on the 2026 season and stories from their playing days in crimson and white.
